desc:
👍 Leave a like for more updates!

🚧 PRE-ALPHA: EARLY TESTING
We hit 800+ players at once, faster than we expected. Thank you 💙

It isn't perfect yet. There's ball chasing, keepers not saving, skill gaps and bugs. We see them all and we're fixing them as fast as we can. You keep everything you unlock now for alpha!

⚠️ HARD FOR NEW PLAYERS
It's 7v7 football that plays like MPS, FUT and Real Futbol, so timing, power and aim are all on you. Practice on the training pitch first.

📜 REAL RULES
• Offsides, fouls, advantage and cards
• Direct and indirect free kicks
• Throw-ins, corners and penalties

🏆 FEATURES
• Matchmaking solo or in a party of 4
• A rating every match
• Curls, chips, volleys, headers, skills and dives
• Unlock boots, gloves and celebrations

🎮 PC, MOBILE AND CONSOLE
🖱️ Right Click shoot · Left Click pass · X dribble · E tackle
📱 On-screen buttons and auto dribble
🎮 B shoot · X pass · Y dribble · RB tackle
